🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth ≥7/11 and both Growth (Tech leaders NVDA/META/GOOGL) and Value/Cyclicals (Financials, Industrials) showing strength; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology strength: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND; Tech breadth est. 20/24 positive (Sector Strength). Financials strong: PYPL (1W: +12.31% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; Financials est. 15/20 positive (Sector Strength).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND; Energy est. 2/10 positive (Sector Weakness). Utilities and Materials show relative weakness: SRE (1W: -4.86% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND; Utilities est. 3/10 positive, Materials est. 5/11 positive.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +18.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +16.46% | 1M: -14.99%) RECOVERY; TSLA (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +2.00%) ABOVE TREND; PLTR (1W: +14.31% | 1M: -4.18%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MPC (1W: -4.01% | 1M: -9.55%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +6.85%) CORRECTION; MO (1W: -4.76% | 1M: +0.18%) CORRECTION; SRE (1W: -4.86% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND; EOG (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Energy and select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +18.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.61% | 1M: +39.57%) ABOVE TREND. Watch RECOVERY divergences NOW (1W: +16.46% | 1M: -14.99%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.31% | 1M: -4.18%) RECOVERY and INTU (1W: +12.06% | 1M: -11.71%) RECOVERY as tactical setups, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is the clear leader with multiple mega-cap drivers. AAPL (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +8.12%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND; Tech breadth est. 20/24 positive (Sector Strength).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing durable strength and contributing to Risk‑On. PYPL (1W: +12.31% | 1M: +13.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND; Financials breadth est. 15/20 positive (Sector Strength).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is mixed but not leading. UNH (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND confirming bullish sentiment, JNJ (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -1.31%) BELOW TREND showing pockets of defensive lag; Healthcare est. 10/17 positive (Internal Rotation).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and tech names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength and trim exposure to Energy and lagging defensives; Financials are constructive in this rotation. Style: Growth/Momentum tilt given NVDA/META/GOOGL leadership but remain selective due to Narrow leadership concentration.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +14.00% | 1M: +7.91%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -5.53% | 1M: +2.76%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (Tech breadth est. 20/24 positive) and Financials (est. 15/20 positive). BEARISH: Energy (est. 2/10 positive) and Utilities (est. 3/10 positive) where negative sentiment and price weakness persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
ORCL breakout continuation above recent highs to confirm ABOVE TREND follow-through. NVDA hold above near-term support to sustain Growth leadership. XOM failing to reclaim 1M trend would keep Energy BELOW TREND and raise sector downside risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WFC (+80): Wells Fargo consent order exit headline; WFC (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +6.85%) CORRECTION — positive news but short-term price weakness, divergence to monitor. UNH (+55): Medicare clarity headline; UNH (1W: +6.67% | 1M: +14.17%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
XOM (-50): price target cut amid geopolitical/war impact; XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): analyst critique post earnings; NFLX (1W: -5.53% | 1M: +2.76%) CORRECTION — bearish sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. EOG (-45): price target trimmed; EOG (1W: -4.97% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND — confirmed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Growth/Momentum style with broad sector breadth (Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive). NVDA (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +11.80%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +26.77% | 1M: +14.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength while Energy names XOM (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND show weakness. Key risk: leadership is narrow (4/5 top performers in Technology) and select sentiment-price divergences (WFC bullish news vs CORRECTION) warrant monitoring.
